name: roboneuro
description: NeuroLibre's editorial bot, built on openjournals/buffy.

addons.comment: Sidekiq's queue. Attached as REDIS, which is what supplies REDIS_URL.
Only COAR Notify uses a relational database. essential-0 is the cheapest plan; there is no free tier.

BUFFY_BOT_GH_USER.description: GitHub login the bot posts as.

BUFFY_GH_ACCESS_TOKEN.description: GitHub token the bot uses to read and comment on review issues.

BUFFY_GH_SECRET_TOKEN.description: Shared secret used to verify incoming GitHub webhook signatures.

JOURNAL_SECRET.description: Shared secret for calls out to the neurolibre.org papers API.

ROBONEURO_SECRET.description: Shared secret roboneuro presents when calling the NeuroLibre API.

PREVIEW_API_USER.description: Basic auth user for preview.neurolibre.org build endpoints.

PREVIEW_API_KEY.description: Basic auth key for preview.neurolibre.org build endpoints.

COAR_NOTIFY_ENABLED.description: Master switch. While false the COAR routes return 503, the release phase skips migrations, and no database is touched.

COAR_OUTBOX_SECRET.description: Required to POST to /coar_notify/outbox. Without it the outbox returns 503 and sends nothing.

COAR_DASHBOARD_USER.description: Basic auth user for /coar_notify/dashboard. The dashboard refuses to serve unless both this and the password are set.

COAR_INBOX_URL.description: Public URL of this instance's inbox, advertised to remote services.

COAR_SERVICE_ID.description: Service identifier used in outgoing notifications.

COAR_IP_WHITELIST_ENABLED.description: Restrict who may POST to the inbox.

COAR_ALLOWED_IPS.description: Comma separated IPs, used only when the whitelist is enabled.

COAR_SQL_LOG_LEVEL.description: DEBUG, INFO, WARN, ERROR or FATAL.

NEUROLIBRE_TESTAPI_USER.description: Basic auth user for the preview.neurolibre.org test API.

NEUROLIBRE_TESTAPI_TOKEN.description: Basic auth token for the preview.neurolibre.org test API.

NEUROLIBRE_API_URL.description: Base URL for the NeuroLibre papers API. Defaults to https://neurolibre.org/papers when unset.

REVIEWS_REPOSITORY.description: Repository holding review issues. Defaults to neurolibre/neurolibre-reviews when unset.

CROSSREF_EMAIL.description: Contact address sent with Crossref API queries. Defaults to noreply@neurolibre.org when unset.
